review: don't want to bind an app to a device. would rather just use a password

Update: 08/24/26 Now I tried to login numerous times, but unfortunately the unique login code is wrong. I've discovered recently that despite my bank card info is accurate and correct, I wasn't able to pay for any order, no matter how small, on my phone in advance. Just because your Debit/Visa or major credit card is in very good standing, doesn't mean you'll have success paying for your order through this McDonald's app. Therefore, I had to remove my payment methods from the McDonald's app.
